steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Every client has a portal. Before you send them there, look at it the way they will.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Open the client. Here, Halvorsen-Quist Properties in San Antonio.

steps.caption: See what the client sees
steps.narration: Under their name is a button called See what the client sees.

steps.caption: Open the preview
steps.narration: Choose it. Their portal opens in a new tab.

steps.caption: Contractor preview
steps.narration: The banner says this is a contractor preview. It is read-only, so nothing you do here is sent.

steps.caption: Needs your action
steps.narration: Home starts with what needs their action. Here, an estimate waiting for review.

steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: The menu on the left is the client's. Choose Estimates.

steps.caption: What you sent
steps.narration: They see the estimate you sent, with its status and its total.

steps.caption: Messages
steps.narration: Messages shows your conversation from their side.

steps.caption: Contact us
steps.narration: And Contact us lists your office, and the person on their job.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Close the preview, and you are back on the client's page.

steps.caption: Copy portal link
steps.narration: Copy portal link copies this client's own portal link, to text or email to them.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Both buttons are on every client's page, under Clients.

youtube.title: How to preview a client's portal | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Check a client's portal before they do. In the ConstructHUB CRM, open a client and choose See what the client sees: a read-only preview of their home page, estimates, messages and your contact details. Recorded in a demo workspace with a made-up client.
